name: opencode
title: OpenCode
description: Use models from your OpenCode Console workspace and OpenCode Go in Raycast AI, or chat with them in Ask OpenCode
author: vimtor

commands.name: ask-opencode
commands.title: Ask OpenCode
commands.description: Chat with OpenCode models and keep the conversation history

commands.name: refresh-models
commands.title: Refresh Models
commands.description: Reload the models available in your OpenCode Console workspace

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: An OpenCode Console API key. Create one under Service Accounts > API Keys.

preferences.name: zen
preferences.title: OpenCode Zen
preferences.label: Show OpenCode Zen models
preferences.description: List the pay-as-you-go models from your OpenCode Console workspace. Uncheck if you only use Go.

preferences.name: go
preferences.title: OpenCode Go
preferences.label: Show OpenCode Go models
preferences.description: List models from your OpenCode Go subscription (same API key) as `<model> (Go)`.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
